entities.summary: The Atacama Giant is an anthropomorphic geoglyph on the Cerro Unita area of the Atacama Desert, Chile. At about 119 meters, is the largest prehispanic anthropomorphic geoglyph. It has been suggested that it represents a shaman, spiritual figure or deity.
